groups.sentence: Sample AI syllabus statements are available to instructors on university resource pages.
Instructors may use, edit and adapt the provided sample syllabus statements for their own courses.
The institution provides sample syllabus language and templates for instructors to use.
Instructors choose and adopt one of the provided sample statements or templates for their syllabus.
Sample statements cover a range of positions, from allowing to restricting or prohibiting AI use.
Instructors are offered tools, guides and resources to help them draft their own AI policy.
Instructors may browse policies and statements from other institutions and educators for ideas.
Instructors may write their own AI policy instead of using a template.
Instructors who use a provided university statement must include it in the syllabus exactly as written.
Instructors include a statement on AI use in their course syllabus.
Instructors discuss the AI policy and its reasons with students and keep the conversation going.
Instructors state, per assignment, the acceptable level of AI use, using assignment templates.
Students may use generative AI tools in the course where the instructor permits it, with attribution.
Consistent syllabus language helps students understand their responsibilities across courses.
Students do not use GenAI tools to summarize, generate or interpret thoughts in their work.
